description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three variants of SimCSE — Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE — across three evaluation metrics: Sentiment Accuracy (light yellow), STS Correlation (pink), and Paraphrase Accuracy (light blue), as presented in the paper “2-Tier SimCSE: Elevating BERT for Robust Sentence Embeddings.” The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation,” ranges from 0.2 to 0.8 with tick marks at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8, indicating a linear scale for performance scores. The horizontal axis lists the three SimCSE variants in order from left to right. For each model, three adjacent bars represent the three metrics, with the legend in the top-right corner clarifying the color coding. Visually, the 2-Tier SimCSE model consistently achieves the highest scores across all three metrics, with its light blue bar (Paraphrase Acc.) reaching approximately 0.78, its pink bar (STS Corr.) around 0.76, and its yellow bar (Sentiment Acc.) near 0.70. Supervised_SimCSE follows with slightly lower performance: Paraphrase Acc. ~0.75, STS Corr. ~0.73, Sentiment Acc. ~0.68. Unsupervised_SimCSE shows the lowest scores: Paraphrase Acc. ~0.70, STS Corr. ~0.65, Sentiment Acc. ~0.55. The chart is tilted diagonally, and all bars are grouped by model, allowing direct comparison of metric performance within each model. The consistent upward trend from left to right suggests that the 2-Tier SimCSE architecture improves performance across all evaluated tasks compared to its predecessors.
